scope: Windows native SYSTEM-only isolated Windows Sandbox same-version Inno Setup transaction protocol. No GitHub update download, old-version upgrade, automatic rollback, publisher authentication or public release.
root_cause: Prior cleanup could clear protected pending stage after matching new Service/Registry/version/sha even when Inno ssPostInstall subsequently failed; there was no native ssDone signal.

mechanism.service: Generate 32-byte cryptographically random transactionId; persist schema 2 in protected pending-update.json; pass /DIMTXN and /DIMSHA256 to Inno; reject legacy pending, stale or orphan receipts; wait for exact per-attempt completion receipt before deleting pinned stage and pending; reparse-point protection; any incomplete/bad receipt retains pending evidence.
mechanism.inno: Reject incomplete/duplicate/malformed txn parameters or wrong source location; only at ssDone after successful ssPostInstall hash actual {srcexe} versus pinned sha and atomically rename protected completion-<txn>.receipt; exit 67 if required receipt cannot be emitted; manual installer without txn remains permitted.
mechanism.native_receipt: DIM-INNO-V1|<64HEX transactionId>|<64HEX SHA256>, exact case-normalized bytes; no trailing newline; namespace exactly protected Program Files Privileged/UpdateTransactions.
limitations: No publisher identity/authenticity proof from SHA-only GitHub asset comparison
No protected actual host publisher signing or legacy migration
Service cleanup is non-atomic across pending/receipt deletion if process killed; orphan receipt prevents next update rather than being silently trusted
One source-tree native fixture uses same-version reinstall, not 1.5.6→1.5.7 upgrade or rollback

build.publisher_signature: Not asserted; test-only; no public release
